adjudication.causal_head_subset: structural AND replication AND necessity AND sufficiency
adjudication.necessity: for the frozen global S, lower 95% bounds of N(S) are above zero for raw and z-scored candidate alignment on validation and test
adjudication.per_relation: report each relation before any shared-mechanism interpretation; relation-specific subsets are separately frozen descriptive causal routes
adjudication.random_and_norm_matched_controls: report the frozen subset against all same-cardinality subsets and the nearest-norm subset; these qualify specificity but cannot replace held-out necessity or sufficiency
adjudication.replication: I_full and I_identity reproduce the unintervened GW-CONV-1 proximal measurements within the frozen numerical tolerance; I_identity logits are bit-identical
adjudication.sufficiency: for the same S, lower 95% bounds of R(S) are at least 0.50 for raw and z-scored candidate alignment on validation and test
adjudication.terminal_transport: report necessity and sufficiency analogues on actual terminal candidate logits; adjudicate separately and do not use them to move S

causal_ladder.excluded_successor: GW-KEY-1: what information the frozen operators read
causal_ladder.later_successor: GW-READ-1: whether the frozen key-to-head path is a cheap read primitive

claim: a frozen subset of L24 attention heads is necessary for and sufficient to recreate a substantial fraction of the control-adjusted semantic alignment
claim_boundary: causal head attribution at the already-frozen L24 attention site only; not source-token or source-key attribution, not correctness, not a compact access key, and not authorization for partial-execution or WALK claims

exact_decomposition.failure_policy: any missing head, duplicate head, non-finite value, geometry drift, parity failure or reconstruction failure aborts before subset search
exact_decomposition.head_contribution: that head value through its matching column slice of the effective prepared-production W_O
exact_decomposition.head_value: the actual production weighted-V output for one L24 query head, before W_O
exact_decomposition.norm_reconstruction: apply the declared L24 post-attention RMSNorm and residual-delta scale, then compare with the actual applied attention delta
exact_decomposition.raw_reconstruction: sum all eight post-W_O head contributions and compare with the actual pre-post-attention-norm output
exact_decomposition.weight_authority: the effective prepared production Q8 W_O, not widened stored checkpoint rows

interpretation_contract.correctness: never inferred; convergence toward a wrong continuation remains allowed
interpretation_contract.necessary_not_sufficient: bottleneck or enabling component, not the complete operation
interpretation_contract.source_key: never inferred; head sufficiency is not source-key sufficiency
interpretation_contract.stable_relation_specific_subsets: candidate common routing stage with specialized operators
interpretation_contract.sufficient_not_necessary: one redundant realization, not a unique causal operator
interpretation_contract.terminal_failure: proximal alignment mechanism not shown to control later answer formation

arms.I_S: heads in S natural/restored; every head outside S replaced
arms.I_full_minus_S: heads in S replaced; every head outside S natural
arms.I_identity: run the intervention machinery while replacing every selected value with its exact original bytes
arms.I_ref: all eight heads replaced by their contribution-norm-matched train references

interventions.frozen_arm_execution: reexecute I_full, I_ref, I_S, I_full_minus_S and I_identity by intervening inside canonical execution at L24 before W_O; capture the proximal carrier, then execute the L24 FFN and every later layer normally for terminal reporting
interventions.local_replay_parity: on every frozen arm, local subset-search replay and intrusive canonical execution must agree on the proximal carrier and selected logits within the exact-decomposition tolerances
interventions.pure_retain_only: secondary only; all-other-heads-zero is not the primary sufficiency intervention

reference_bank.direction: mean production head-value direction from train rows only
reference_bank.held_out_evaluation: single bank frozen from every train edge and no held-out row
reference_bank.scaling: scale the bank vector so its effective W_O-slice contribution L2 equals the natural row/head contribution L2
reference_bank.zero_or_nonfinite_policy: refuse; do not substitute zero or another grouping

secondary_arms: zero S with every non-S head natural
nearest-total-contribution-norm subsets at the same cardinality
interventions.train_search_execution: capture each natural row's L24 entering carrier and eight production head values once; for every candidate subset, compose natural/reference head values before W_O, then execute the effective W_O, declared post-attention norm, residual write and frozen selected-row readout; this is the exact local operator path, not isolated-vector projection

measurements.E: for each arm I and proximal metric, E(I) = same-fact before-to-after gain under I minus the frozen matched-control gain under I; signs normalized so larger means more alignment

candidate_raw.similarity: negative mean pairwise Jensen-Shannon divergence over the 126-token restricted softmax

candidate_zscore.gain: z-score JS before minus z-score JS after
candidate_zscore.similarity: negative mean pairwise JS after independently z-scoring each state's 126 logits

carrier.similarity: mean of the three pairwise carrier cosines in a same-fact prompt triplet

measurements.carrier_role: qualification only: report absolute same-fact and adjusted carrier effects; it cannot rescue either semantic readout
measurements.matched_control: the three frozen same-split, same-relation, same-prompt-family, different-subject-and-target rows already bound by GW-SUP-1
measurements.proximal: the recomputed real carrier immediately after the intervened L24 post-norm residual write, read through the unchanged frozen candidate basis
measurements.sufficiency: R(S) = (E(I_S) - E(I_ref)) / (E(I_full) - E(I_ref)); refuse a non-positive or numerically unstable denominator
measurements.terminal: the actual next-token logits after the remainder of canonical execution; mandatory report and qualification, not a substitute selection surface

question: does a train-selected frozen subset of L24 attention heads causally account for the GW-CONV-1 control-adjusted semantic-alignment effect?

selection.eligible: positive train E(I_full) and R(S) >= 0.80 independently for candidate_raw and candidate_zscore under the primary I_S intervention
selection.global_subset: select from all 85 train edges only
selection.relation_subsets: independently select within each relation's train stratum; each identity freezes before any validation/test execution
selection.search: exhaustive direct execution of all 256 subsets through the exact L24 W_O -> post-norm -> residual -> selected-readout path using once-captured natural head values; no singleton-score summation, isolated projection or top-k approximation
tie_break: higher minimum of raw and z-scored retained fractions
validation_or_test_may_not: select, add, drop or reorder a head
change an intervention arm, retention fraction or tie-break

site.intervention_position: the final prompt/capture position only; prefix positions and every other layer/site remain natural

statistics.interval: 10000-sample percentile cluster bootstrap over semantic edges
